creative_direction.name: Olive Grove Ledger
creative_direction.brief: A constructed graphic ledger: three flat matte olive plywood panels of slightly shifted tone stacked as horizontal colour blocks, the middle block carrying the whole image weight. The flacon rests low-right on the panel seam implied by the block edge, while the left column holds a wrapped Century Gothic name set across two lines at generous size, brand above and eau de parfum below, plus a short rule under the column. No floor, no horizon: the block seams act as the only architecture, and the geometric sans against lacquered glass keeps the poster crisp, modern and quietly agricultural in its olive秩序.
creative_direction.material: flat matte painted plywood panels in stacked colour blocks
creative_direction.lighting: even shadowless studio illumination across painted panels, flat graphic light
